paths.name: Path of Vengeance
paths.description: A mastery path focused on offence

ability.name: Overprotective
ability.description: Whenever your Oath Friend is attacked, there is a 25% chance that you toss the assailant a glare so fierce they take 225 damage.

ability.name: Ancestor's Fury
ability.description: The memory of your ancestors bolsters your resolve, increasing Strength by 150 and chance to critically hit by 10% for 20 seconds. Your Oath Friend is affected as well if they're within 50 feet of you.

ability.name: Powered Etchings
ability.description: Rune Etched Axe will now Knockback other players and Knockdown monsters and decrease their movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Cave-In
ability.description:
You smash into your enemy, knocking them down for 3 seconds.

 At 25 Grudges: Deals 230 damage over 5 seconds.
 At 50 Grudges: Deals 415 damage over 5 seconds.
 At 75 Grudges: Deals 605 damage over 5 seconds.
 At 100 Grudges: Deals 790 damage over 5 seconds.

ability.name: Greataxe Mastery
ability.description:
When you are wielding a great weapon, your chance to parry is increased by 5% and all damage you deal is increased by 10%.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Grudge-Born Fury
ability.description:
You constantly pummel your target with brutal attacks, dealing up to 1175 damage over 3 seconds. Your attacks will end if you lose your concentration.

 At 25 Grudge: Chance to Critically hit is increased by 5%.
 At 50 Grudge: Chance to Critically hit is increased by 10%.
 At 75 Grudge: Chance to Critically hit is increased by 15%.
 At 100 Grudge: Chance to Critically hit is increased by 20% and armor penetration is increased by 10%.

ability.name: Axe Slam
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 65 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Binding Grudge
coreAbilities.description:
You chop at your enemy's legs, causing them to take 340 damage over 10 seconds and snaring them, reducing their run speed by 40%.

 With 25 Grudges: Damages for 495 damage over 10 seconds.
 With 50 Grudges: Damages for 630 damage over 10 seconds.
 With 75 Grudges: Damages for 780 damage over 10 seconds.
 With 100 Grudges: Damages for 930 damage over 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Heavy Blow
coreAbilities.description:
You strike a crushing blow for 179 damage.

 With 25 Grudges: Deals 120 damage over 3 seconds.
 With 50 Grudges: Deals 192 damage over 3 seconds.
 With 75 Grudges: Deals 264 damage over 3 seconds.
 With 100 Grudges: Deals 333 damage over 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Stone Breaker
coreAbilities.description:
A powerful attack that smashes through your enemy's protections, dealing 194 damage and reducing their armor based on Grudges for 20 seconds.

 At 25 Grudges: Reduces armor by 320.
  At 50 Grudges: Reduces armor by 640.
 At 75 Grudges: Reduces armor by 960.
 At 100 Grudges: Reduces armor by 1280.

coreAbilities.name: Rune-Etched Axe
coreAbilities.description:
You whirl your axe around, dealing 137 damage to enemies 25 feet in front of you.

 At 25 Grudges: Ignores 25% of the victim's armor.
 At 50 Grudges: Ignores 50% of the victim's armor.
 At 75 Grudges: Ignores 75% of the victim's armor.
 At 100 Grudges: Ignores 100% of the victim's armor.

coreAbilities.name: Kneecapper
coreAbilities.description:
A painful strike to the enemy's leg that deals 156 damage.

   At 25 Grudges:  Also reduces the target's chance to critically hit by 5% for 10 seconds.
   At 50 Grudges:  Also reduces the target's chance to critically hit by 10% for 10 seconds.
   At 75 Grudges:  Also reduces the target's chance to critically hit by 15% for 10 seconds.
   At 100 Grudges:  Also reduces the target's chance to critically hit by 20% for 10 seconds.

paths.name: Path of Stone
paths.description: A mastery path focused on defense and protection

ability.name: Furious Reprisal
ability.description: Shield Of Reprisal will also increase the cooldown times of the enemy's abilities by an additional 5 seconds for the next 5 seconds.

ability.name: Oathbound
ability.description: Strengthens the ties between you and your Oath Friend, increasing Initiative by 150 and chance to parry by 20% for 20 seconds. Your Oath Friend is affected as well if they're within 50 feet of you.

ability.name: Oath of Vengeance
ability.description: Vengeful Strike will now also affect all other allies within 20 feet of your Oath Friend, but those allies will only gain 100 Toughness.

ability.name: Avenging the Debt
ability.description: Upon spotting a hated foe your rage boils over. You remove all movement impairing effects. For each effect removed, you will regain 427 health. You will be immune to snares and roots for the next 3 seconds. Your Oath Friend will be affected as well if they're within 50 feet of you.

ability.name: Shield Mastery
ability.description: Increases your chance to block attacks by 10%, and you take only 95% damage from all attacks while you are holding a shield.

ability.name: Oathstone
ability.description:
You declare that this is where you're making your stand, and nothing will change your mind. You are almost guaranteed to block up to the next 4 attacks made against you within 10 seconds, and you will deal 150 damage back to the attacker each time you block.

 With 25 Grudges: Deals 300 damage.
 With 50 Grudges: Deals 450 damage.
 With 75 Grudges: Deals 600 damage.
 With 100 Grudges: Deals 750 damage.

You gain Immovable for 6 seconds, also grants Immovable to your Oath Friend if they are within 50 feet.

ability.name: Strength In Numbers
ability.description: Increases your chance to block attacks by 100% for 10 seconds, and increases chances to dodge, parry, and disrupt attacks by 25% to all group members within 100 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Grudging Blow
coreAbilities.description: A vicious attack that deals 156 damage, and causes monsters to hate you much more than normal.

coreAbilities.name: Vengeful Strike
coreAbilities.description:
You strike your enemy for 156 damage and stubbornly push yourself to keep fighting, increasing your Toughness by 150 for 20 seconds.
Your Oath Friend's Toughness will also be increased if they are within 50 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Shield of Reprisal
coreAbilities.description: A furious counterattack that deals 269 damage and will knock your target down for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Shield Sweep
coreAbilities.description:
You bring your shield around in a smashing hit, dealing 185 damage to up to five enemies within 25 feet of them.
When hitting targets you regain 10 Grudges for each target that you hit.

coreAbilities.name: Away With Ye
coreAbilities.description: A dismissive strike that deals 344 damage and knocks the enemy away.

paths.name: Path of Brotherhood
paths.description: A mastery path focused on supporting and bolstering you and your allies

ability.name: Avalanche
ability.description: When you disrupt an enemy's spell, your run speed will be increased by 30% for 5 seconds and you will recover 135 health.

ability.name: Runic Shield
ability.description: You invoke a powerful rune that you've learned, and become surrounded by a protective barrier for 10 seconds which will absorb up to 937 non-physical damage. Your Oath Friend will be affected as well if they're within 50 feet of you. During this time, you will gain 15 Grudges each time you're hit by an enemy spell.

ability.name: Punishing Knock
ability.description: Inspiring Attack will also curse your target, reducing the value of their outgoing healing by 50% for 15 seconds.

ability.name: Earthshatter
ability.description:
The ground around you cracks and shatters and snares all enemies within 25 feet, reducing their run speed by 30% for 5 seconds.

 At 25 Grudge: Deals 207 damage to each enemy hit by the effect.
 At 50 Grudge: Deals 357 damage to each enemy hit by the effect.
 At 75 Grudge: Deals 507 damage to each enemy hit by the effect.
 At 100 Grudge: Deals 657 damage to each enemy hit by the effect.

ability.name: Told Ya So!
ability.description: Any time you spend grudges, each group member within 50 feet will gain 25 Action Points. This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

ability.name: Blood of Grimnir
ability.description: Deals 245 damage to all targets within 25 feet. Increases your auto attack damage by 25% for 20 seconds. Your Oath Friend and all group members within 50 feet of you will also gain 25% auto attack damage for 20 seconds.

ability.name: Earthen Renewal
ability.description: Group members within 100 feet regain 1197 health and 240 Action Points over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Guarded Attack
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 156 damage to your target and prepare yourself for their attacks, increasing your armor by 594 for 20 seconds.
Your Oath Friend's armor will also be increased if they are within 50 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Inspiring Attack
coreAbilities.description:
A brutal attack that deals 194 damage to your target and inspires you to push the attack, increasing your Strength by 150 for 20 seconds. Will also affect your Oath Friend if they are within 50 feet. 

   At 25 Grudges:  Also increases Willpower by 150.
   At 50 Grudges: Also increases Willpower by 250.
   At 75 Grudges: Also increases Willpower by 350.
   At 100 Grudges:  Also increases Willpower by 450.

coreAbilities.name: Stubborn As Stone
coreAbilities.description:
You set your mind to the task at hand and focus on what must be done, increasing your Corporeal resistance by 360 for 20 seconds. Each time you're hit by magical attack while this effect is active, your autoattack speed will be increased by 50% for 20 seconds.
Also increases your Oath Friend's resistance if they are within 50 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Watch An' Learn
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Weapon Skill by 150 for 10 seconds. Each time you hit an enemy, your Oath Friend will gain 25 Action Points as long as they're within 50 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Punishing Blow
coreAbilities.description: You maim your target's legs, dealing 119 damage, and for 10 seconds causing them to suffer 112 damage for every half second they are moving.

coreAbilities.name: Deflect Oil
coreAbilities.description: 50% reduction in damage taken by Oil siege engines. You will also protect two other group mates within 30 feet. Only one effect of this type may be on a player at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Modify War Engine
coreAbilities.description: You shield the Ram absorbing 1500 damage over the next 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bulwark
coreAbilities.description: Repairs a friendly keep door for 5% of its total health over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Axe Toss
coreAbilities.description: A basic throwing attack that inflicts 79 damage. Has a chance to deal 678 damage to a severely wounded target if you are behind them.

coreAbilities.name: Oath Friend
coreAbilities.description:
You select a single ally to be your sworn Oath Friend. Each time they are attacked, you will gain Grudges based on your current Grudge level, and some of your abilities will affect them as well.
You are at 0-29 Grudge: You will gain 10 Grudges.
You are at 30-59 Grudge: You will gain 5 Grudges.
You are at 60-100 Grudge: You will gain 3 Grudge.

coreAbilities.name: Guard
coreAbilities.description:
You defend one of your groupmates and try to take attacks meant for them.  As long as you are within 30 feet of them, any damage that they suffer will be split evenly between the two of you, and 35% of all hate that they cause will be redirected to you.

Damage received from this ability can be blocked or parried, unless the original attack was undefendable.

coreAbilities.name: Grudge Unleashed
coreAbilities.description: You focus on your Grudges to ready yourself for action, restoring 160 AP.

coreAbilities.name: Taunt
coreAbilities.description:
You enrage your opponent, interrupting any currently building abilities and increasing their hate towards you. While taunted your opponent will take 30% more damage from your attacks. This effect will fade after 15 seconds or after your opponent has hit you 3 times.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Demolishing Strike
coreAbilities.description: A powerful melee attack that reduces  your target's armor by 1056 and deals 900 damage over 15 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Stoutness of Stone
coreAbilities.description: Increases Toughness by 80. You also recover from Stuns, Staggers and Knockdowns 1 seconds quicker. You will still gain immunity based on the original duration.

coreAbilities.name: Hold The Line!
coreAbilities.description:
You focus your defenses against enemy fire, increasing your chances to dodge and disrupt by 45% for 12 seconds. You will also defend all allies behind you, up to 50 feet away, increasing their chances to dodge and disrupt by 15% as long as they remain at your back. Allies may have this effect stacked on them up to 3 times.
This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.

coreAbilities.name: Juggernaut
coreAbilities.description: You become filled with unstoppable power, removing all snaring, rooting, silencing, and disarming effects. For the next 5 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you.

coreAbilities.name: Shield Wall
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, your chance to block is almost guaranteed.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Offense
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 15% more damage and all enemy monsters will hate you 15% less than normal, but your armor is reduced by 33%.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Blessing
coreAbilities.description: You sever one Blessing from your enemy and deal 119 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Rising Anger
coreAbilities.description: Each time you hit an enemy, you gain 5 Grudge. This effect will not trigger more than once per 0.5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Rugged
coreAbilities.description: Increases Toughness by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Champion's Challenge
coreAbilities.description:
Both you and your target are held tightly in place for 10 seconds, and neither one of you can move.
This effect cannot be dispelled or broken.

coreAbilities.name: Challenge
coreAbilities.description: You challenge all opponents in front of you, forcing monsters to attack you. While challenged, your opponents will deal only 70% damage to everyone other than you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Stubbornness
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Corporeal resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Grip of Stone
coreAbilities.description: You shatter the ground for 25 feet around you, rooting up to four enemies in place for 5 seconds. There is a 50% chance of the root breaking with every hit.

coreAbilities.name: Raze
coreAbilities.description: You repeatedly attack all enemies in a line in front of you, inflicting 300 damage every second  for 3 seconds, up to 65 feet away, for as long as you maintain your concentration.

coreAbilities.name: Long-Held Grudge
coreAbilities.description:
All of your damaging attacks will cause additional hate based on Grudge.
 At 25 Grudges: Adds an additional 15 threat.
 At 50 Grudges: Adds an additional 20 threat.
 At 75 Grudges: Adds an additional 25 threat.
 At 100 Grudges:  Adds an additional 30 threat.

coreAbilities.name: Ancestral Inheritance
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Armor by 660.

coreAbilities.name: Distracting Bellow
coreAbilities.description: A loud shout that startles your target and all enemies within 25 feet of them, reducing their damage to 60% for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Menace
coreAbilities.description: Enemy monsters will hate you 100% more than normal on all attacks.

coreAbilities.name: Sweet Revenge
coreAbilities.description: Increases your chance to critically hit by 15% if you are above 50 Grudge.

coreAbilities.name: Rock Clutch
coreAbilities.description: Deals 900 damage to your target and roots them in place for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Unstoppable Juggernaut
coreAbilities.description: Juggernaut's cooldown is reduced to 40 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Seasoned Veteran
coreAbilities.description: Whenever you block an attack you will take only 85% damage for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Skin of Iron
coreAbilities.description: All damage you take is reduced by 100% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Seen It All Before
coreAbilities.description: Snares last half duration against you and when you are critically hit by an enemy, the bonus damage that you suffer is reduced by 15%.

coreAbilities.name: Dwarven Riposte
coreAbilities.description: Whenever you Parry you also build 30 Grudge. This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Gromril Plating
coreAbilities.description: You become protected by a barrier which will absorb up to 7200 damage for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Relentless Training
coreAbilities.description: Grudging Blow and Heavy Blow will cost 15 fewer action points.

coreAbilities.name: Long Reach
coreAbilities.description: Extends the reach of Shield Sweep and Rune-Etched Axe by an additional 5 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Immaculate Defense
coreAbilities.description: An impressive display of defense which reduces incoming damage by 75% for both you and all group members within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.
